source: https://bus.dillo.dev/api/ — this project's own generated output, not a CapMetro feed
why: The bug: a run whose scheduled time had passed, whose bus was still finishing the
trip before, vanished from the stop board. Captured live while it was happening,
on request, before the state resolved itself — so this is the failure, not a
5th/Guadalupe) was to be run by bus 8007, which was 820s late finishing its
southbound trip 3012136_24864 and did not take the northbound run over until
17:13:56. Between 17:04:30 (its time plus the 90s grace) and 17:13:56 the board
listed nothing for it, and a rider at 5th/Guadalupe was shown the 17:33 as their
next bus while their actual bus was ten minutes out.
The trip is present in departures-837.json and is NOT in schedule.canceled_trips.
Nothing upstream was wrong: health.json reported ok, positions_source json,
oldest_feed_age_s 47, schedule_state current. The board had every number it
needed and threw the row away.

departures-837.json.note: The service day's schedule. One document, unchanged all day; service_day_start_epoch 1789621200.

route-837-pending.json.note: The reported moment. Bus 8007 is on the SOUTHBOUND 3012136_24864, very_late by 820s, and publishes block.next_trip.trip_id == 3012264_24429. Nothing is on the northbound run. This is the state that made the row disappear.

route-837-handover.json.note: 8007 has taken over 3012264_24429, very_late by 681s. The run reappears on its own here, which is what made the bug look like it fixed itself. Kept so a test can assert the fix changes nothing once a bus is actually on the trip.

route-837-canceled-stack.json.note: Seven cancellations on the route, three of them stacked at stop 2112 northbound with the oldest 27 minutes gone. A canceled trip reads as `overdue` to coverageFor, so it used to inherit OVERDUE_KEEP_S (30 min) — a window meant for a no-show CapMetro has NOT announced. This snapshot is what CANCELED_KEEP_S is measured against.

predictor_accuracy.note: Evidence that extrapolating from the inbound bus is worth doing, measured on these files rather than asserted.
predictor_accuracy.at_17_12_36: 8007 was 748s late, so scheduled 17:03 + 748 predicted a 17:15:28 departure.
predictor_accuracy.actual: 8007 took the run at 17:13:56 running 681s late, i.e. 17:14:21 at the origin.

pii: None. This is generated API output: vehicle ids, trip ids, stop names and times. No staff identities, unlike feeds-20260819/servicealerts.json.
